items.name: Faithforged Scepter
items.description: The Faithforged Scepter is a masterfully crafted war hammer made from the rare and durable metal known as glaucite. Its head shimmers with a faint divine glow, a testament to its holy creation. The handle is wrapped in white leather, and ancient runes of faith are etched along its length. Said to be forged by a devout sect of clerics, it is believed to carry the blessings of their deity, making it a revered artifact among the faithful. items.name: Glaucite Plating - Heavy
items.description: This metal suit comprises multiple pieces of interconnected and overlaying metal plates, incorporating the benefits of numerous types of lesser armor. A complete suit of full plate (or platemail, as it is often called) includes gauntlets, heavy leather boots, a visored helmet, and a thick layer of padding that is worn underneath the armor. Each suit of full plate must be individually fitted to its owner by a master armorsmith, although a captured suit can be resized to fit a new owner at a cost
